title: Introducing: Extending Copilot Chat with Your App's Documentation (2025 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Introduction and overview of Copilot app integration
Demo: Copilot answering questions about the Fabricam app
How Copilot finds and uses app documentation
Prerequisites: help property in app.json and public documentation
Documentation requirements: indexing, site structure, and redirects
Format and testing recommendations for documentation
Next steps and future evolution of the feature

features.name: Copilot Chat with app documentation
features.description: Copilot can answer questions about installed add-on apps by searching their online documentation. Users can ask about app functionality, configuration, and troubleshooting, with answers grounded in the app's help documentation.
caveats: Site must be publicly accessible and indexed by Bing
No authentication or password walls allowed
Copilot searches up to two levels deep from the help link URL
Can take a few days for new sites to be indexed by Bing

features.name: Help property in app.json
features.description: Partners must add a help property to their app.json file that points to their online documentation. This enables Copilot to discover and search the app's help documentation.
caveats: Partners are accountable for what is at the end of that link
Documentation link must point to a public, internet-accessible site

features.name: Bing search integration with Copilot
features.description: Copilot uses Microsoft Bing search to find answers within app documentation websites. It transforms user questions into search terms and searches only the specified documentation site.
caveats: Site must be indexed by Bing
Site must be public with no authentication required
Indexing can take several days after site publication or updates

features.name: Bing Webmaster Tools integration
features.description: Partners can use Bing Webmaster Tools to ensure proper indexing of their documentation sites and to accelerate the discovery process for Copilot.

features.name: Documentation site structure requirements
features.description: Copilot searches content at the defined help URL and up to two levels down. Partners should avoid deep URL structures and should not use redirects or URL shorteners that point to different domains.
caveats: URL redirects to different domains will not work
Content may need restructuring to match Copilot's search depth

features.name: Documentation format support
features.description: Copilot works primarily with text on web pages. It ignores illustrations and icons but can process text within Excel and PDF files hosted on the documentation website.
caveats: PDF and Excel files must be hosted on the website
